summary: The PROJEXA-side diff (proxy routes for materials/budget/schedule/manpower plus a new Site Materials UI) is additive and mostly follows the existing labour-roster proxy convention correctly (requireAuth + projectId validation + typed VeridianApiError handling), but it ships two real, verifiable defects rather than just leaving them as documented TODOs: (1) the new `/site-materials` page route is not added to `PROTECTED_PREFIXES` in src/middleware.ts, so it is reachable by unauthenticated visitors -- resolveSelectedProject() then falls back to the shared demo VERIDIAN_API_KEY (per veridian-client.ts's resolveApiKey precedence) and server-renders that fallback org's project data to an anonymous request, unlike every sibling protected page; and (2) src/app/api/schedule-tracker/import/route.ts passes a FormData object as `body` into callVeridianRaw(), but that function unconditionally does `JSON.stringify(options.body)` and sets `Content-Type: application/json` whenever body is truthy -- JSON.stringify(FormData) serializes to "{}", so the uploaded Excel file's bytes are silently dropped before ever reaching VERIDIAN despite a misleading application/json content-type. The worker's own PROGRESS.md flags issue (2) as 'unverified' and issue (1) as remaining nav/middleware wiring, so these are not hidden, but they are shipped as live, reachable code in this PR rather than gated behind the missing pieces. No .github/workflows changes are present. Neither issue is individually catastrophic (no cross-tenant sensitive data is exposed since client-side data fetches still require auth, and the import route has no UI wired to it yet), but both are concrete, reproducible bugs that should be fixed before merge rather than merged and patched later.
issues: src/middleware.ts PROTECTED_PREFIXES is missing '/site-materials', so the new page bypasses the login redirect that every sibling project-scoped page gets, and falls back to rendering the shared demo VERIDIAN_API_KEY's project data for unauthenticated requests via resolveSelectedProject()/callVeridian() organizationId-undefined fallback.

src/app/api/schedule-tracker/import/route.ts forwards a FormData body through callVeridianRaw(), but callVeridianRaw (src/lib/veridian-client.ts) always JSON.stringifies options.body and sets Content-Type: application/json when body is truthy -- JSON.stringify(FormData) produces '{}', so the uploaded file's actual bytes are never sent to VERIDIAN despite an outwardly-successful-looking request; needs either a callVeridianRaw variant that special-cases FormData (skip stringify/content-type override) or a direct fetch() in this route.

New routes/page are not registered in AppSidebar.tsx nav or middleware.ts, and messages/ i18n keys were not added -- acknowledged in PROGRESS.md as remaining work, but means the feature ships partially wired.
